intro: Croaky's Head is the severed bounty from a menacing murloc leader who terrorized the roads of eastern Elwynn Forest. Bringing proof of the creature's death to the Stormwind guard at Ridgepoint Tower offers grim relief to a garrison grieving their fallen comrades. It marks an essential victory for local defenders struggling to secure Elwynn's contested waterways.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: This murloc has no doubt been terrorizing the local roads for some time. You suspect the nearby watch guards will want to know of its demise.

clips.title: Completion
paras: We lost two members of the watch last week to the murlocs, adventurer. Hopefully with their leader slain, we can start pushing them out of Elwynn.
